greek: Καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

notes.text: The verse ends without a stop, as the page prints it.

greek: Ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου νουμηνίᾳ στήσεις τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου
hint: The tent of witness is to be set up on the first day of the first month.

notes.text: Capitalised by the edition as the first word of direct speech.
νουμηνία, the new moon, the first of the month, then true new moon: without the article the Greek does not have.
μήν, a month, Middle Liddell's one translation: plain.

greek: καὶ προέθηκεν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς ἄρτους τῆς προθέσεως ἔναντι κυρίου, ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ. —
hint: He sets out on it the bread of the setting-out before the Lord, as the Lord ordered.

notes.text: προτίθημι's active aorist, as προθήσεις at 40:4.

reading: and [[placed|placed or set before and set out, threw, handed over to and gave over to, exposed, set up as a mark or prize and proposed, proposed as a penalty, set forth and fixed and set, proposed, laid out, let it lie in state, set out for show or sale, proposed and brought forward, appointed and held, put forward, held out, put before, preferred|προτίθημι]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] of her [[cakes|cakes, loaves of wheat-bread, breads|ἄρτος]] [[of the placing in public|of the placing in public, of the laying out, of the public notice, of the statement, of the purpose and end proposed, of the supposition and calculation|πρόθεσις]] in the presence of [[of lord|of lord / master, of the head, of master, of the Lord, of Jehovah|κύριος]], which [[turn|turn, direction, course, way, manner and fashion, way of life and habit and custom, character and temper, manner and style, tropes and figures|τρόπος]] [[put in order together|put in order together, drew up and put in array, arranged and organised, concocted, fixed and assessed, ordained and prescribed|συντάσσω]] [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]] to the [[name:Μωυσῇ]]. —

greek: καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν λυχνίαν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου εἰς τὸ κλίτος τῆς σκηνῆς τὸ πρὸς νότον
hint: He sets the lampstand in the tent on its south side.

notes.text: The article over the phrase, neuter with κλίτος: the thing.

reading: and [[set|set, put, placed, planted, laid|τίθημι]] the lampstand [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the covered place|the covered place and tent, the camp, the dwelling-place, the temple|σκηνή]] [[of the testimony|of the testimony and proof|μαρτύριον]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] the clime [[of the covered place|of the covered place and tent, of the camp, of the dwelling-place, of the temple|σκηνή]], the thing [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[south|south and south-west wind, Notus, south and south-west quarter|νότος]]

greek: καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τοὺς λύχνους αὐτῆς ἔναντι κυρίου, ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ. —
hint: He sets its lamps before the Lord, as the Lord ordered.

notes.text: in the presence of, plain, as at 39:11.

reading: and [[laid|laid, put, placed upon, applied, set up, put on, put to and shut, put to and granted and gave besides, added and brought on, imposed and inflicted, dispatched, gave|ἐπιτίθημι]] [[the portable lights|the portable lights and lamps, the lamp-market|λύχνος]] of her in the presence of [[of lord|of lord / master, of the head, of master, of the Lord, of Jehovah|κύριος]], which [[turn|turn, direction, course, way, manner and fashion, way of life and habit and custom, character and temper, manner and style, tropes and figures|τρόπος]] [[put in order together|put in order together, drew up and put in array, arranged and organised, concocted, fixed and assessed, ordained and prescribed|συντάσσω]] [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]] to the [[name:Μωυσῇ]]. —

greek: καὶ ἔθηκεν τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἀπέναντι τοῦ καταπετάσματος
hint: He sets the gold altar in the tent, facing the veil.

notes.text: The verse ends without a stop, as the page prints it.

reading: and [[set|set, put, placed, planted, laid|τίθημι]] the altar [[the golden|the golden, the of gold, the decked and inlaid with gold, the gilded and gilt, the gold-coloured and golden-yellow|χρυσοῦς]] [[in the covered place|within, inside of, and by means of the covered place and tent, the camp, the dwelling-place, the temple|ἐν; σκηνή]] [[of the testimony|of the testimony and proof|μαρτύριον]] [[opposite|opposite and against|ἀπέναντι]] [[of the curtain|of the curtain and veil|καταπέτασμα]]

greek: καὶ ἐθυμίασεν ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ τὸ θυμίαμα τῆς συνθέσεως, καθάπερ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ. —
hint: He burns the compounded incense on it, as the Lord ordered.

notes.text: θυμιάω, to burn so as to produce smoke, burn: one translation, one item.

reading: and [[burned so as to produce smoke|burned so as to produce smoke and burned|θυμιάω]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] of it [[the that which is burnt as incense|the that which is burnt as incense, the fragrant stuffs, the stuff for embalming|θυμίαμα]] [[of the putting together|of the putting together and composition and combination, of the composition, of the agreement and treaty, of the suit of clothes, of the loose gown|σύνθεσις]], [[according as|according as and just as, like as if and exactly as|καθάπερ]] [[put in order together|put in order together, drew up and put in array, arranged and organised, concocted, fixed and assessed, ordained and prescribed|συντάσσω]] [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]] to the [[name:Μωυσῇ]]. —

greek: καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῶν καρπωμάτων ἔθηκεν παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς
hint: He sets the altar of offerings beside the tent's doors.

notes.text: Rahlfs prints no 40:28, and the module has none.

reading: and the altar [[of the fruits|of the fruits, of the profits, of the offerings of fruits|κάρπωμα]] [[set|set, put, placed, planted, laid|τίθημι]] [[to the side of|to the side of, motion alongside of, to, beside and near and by, passing by, beyond, contrary to and against, beside and except, on account of and because of and by means of, along the whole course of and during|παρά + accusative]] [[the doors|the doors, the folding doors, the gates, the courts, the trap-doors, the frames of planks and rafts, the entrances|θύρα]] [[of the covered place|of the covered place and tent, of the camp, of the dwelling-place, of the temple|σκηνή]]

greek: καὶ ἔστησεν τὴν αὐλὴν κύκλῳ τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου. καὶ συνετέλεσεν Μωυσῆς πάντα τὰ ἔργα.
hint: He sets up the court round the tent and the altar, and Moses completes all the work.

notes.text: Rahlfs prints no 40:30–32, and the module has none.
Before a genitive, coded a preposition, as at 16:13; the unit is the adverb's.

reading: and [[made to stand|made to stand, set, stopped and stayed and checked, set up and raised, established and instituted, appointed, weighed|ἵστημι]] [[the court-yard|the court-yard, the wall of the court-yard, the court, the quadrangle, the any court, the hall|αὐλή]] [[in a circle|in a circle, in a ring and round about|κύκλῳ]] [[of the covered place|of the covered place and tent, of the camp, of the dwelling-place, of the temple|σκηνή]] and of the altar. and [[brought quite to an end|brought quite to an end and completed and accomplished, made up the whole and the number, paid towards common expenses and contributed, belonged to a class and was counted in it|συντελέω]] [[name:Μωυσῆς]] [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] [[the works|the works, the business, the deeds|ἔργον]].

greek: Καὶ ἐκάλυψεν ἡ νεφέλη τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ δόξης κυρίου ἐπλήσθη ἡ σκηνή·
hint: The cloud covers the tent of witness, and the tent is filled with the Lord's glory.

notes.text: Without the article: of notion, δόξα's first sense, its range running to glory.

reading: And [[covered with|covered with, covered, covered and grasped, buried, covered and concealed, covered with dishonour and threw a cloud over, put over as a covering|καλύπτω]] [[the cloud|the cloud, the bird-net|νεφέλη]] [[the covered place|the covered place and tent, the camp, the dwelling-place, the temple|σκηνή]] [[of the testimony|of the testimony and proof|μαρτύριον]], and [[of notion|of notion, of expectation, of opinion and judgment, of mere opinion and conjecture, of fancy and vision and dream, of opinion which others have of one and the estimation and reputation and credit and honour and glory, of estimate popularly formed of a thing, of glory and splendour and effulgence|δόξα]] [[of lord|of lord / master, of the head, of master, of the Lord, of Jehovah|κύριος]] [[was filled full of|was filled full of, was filled with, was filled up and filled, became full of and was full of, had enough of|πίμπλημι]] [[the covered place|the covered place and tent, the camp, the dwelling-place, the temple|σκηνή]];

greek: καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθη Μωυσῆς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου, ὅτι ἐπεσκίαζεν ἐπʼ αὐτὴν ἡ νεφέλη καὶ δόξης κυρίου ἐπλήσθη ἡ σκηνή.
hint: Moses cannot go in, because the cloud overshadows the tent and the Lord's glory fills it.

notes.text: Imperfect of ἐπισκιάζω, to throw a shade upon, overshadow: one translation, one item. The passive participle's example, keeping a hidden watch, is set aside.

reading: and not [[was able|was able and capable and strong enough, dared and bore, passed for, was worth, was equivalent to, signified and meant|δύναμαι]] [[name:Μωυσῆς]] [[to go in|to go in, to go into and enter, to come into, to come in, to come upon|εἰσέρχομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the covered place|the covered place and tent, the camp, the dwelling-place, the temple|σκηνή]] [[of the testimony|of the testimony and proof|μαρτύριον]], [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] [[was throwing a shade upon|was throwing a shade upon and overshadowing|ἐπισκιάζω]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] her [[the cloud|the cloud, the bird-net|νεφέλη]] and [[of notion|of notion, of expectation, of opinion and judgment, of mere opinion and conjecture, of fancy and vision and dream, of opinion which others have of one and the estimation and reputation and credit and honour and glory, of estimate popularly formed of a thing, of glory and splendour and effulgence|δόξα]] [[of lord|of lord / master, of the head, of master, of the Lord, of Jehovah|κύριος]] [[was filled full of|was filled full of, was filled with, was filled up and filled, became full of and was full of, had enough of|πίμπλημι]] [[the covered place|the covered place and tent, the camp, the dwelling-place, the temple|σκηνή]].

greek: ἡνίκα δʼ ἂν ἀνέβη ἡ νεφέλη ἀπὸ τῆς σκηνῆς, ἀνεζεύγνυσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ σὺν τῇ ἀπαρτίᾳ αὐτῶν·
hint: The Israelites break camp with their goods whenever the cloud goes up from the tent.

notes.text: Not in Middle Liddell. LSJ, citing this verse: household utensils, movables, chattels, then spoil, public auction.
Imperfect of ἀναζεύγνυμι, each sense in the imperfect: were yoking again, were moving off.

reading: [[at which time|at which time and when, since, whenever|ἡνίκα]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], ever [[went up|went up, mounted, ascended, went up to, rose, came up, came to and arrived at, went up country, went aboard|ἀναβαίνω]] [[the cloud|the cloud, the bird-net|νεφέλη]] [[from|from, away from, far from, apart from|ἀπό]] [[of the covered place|of the covered place and tent, of the camp, of the dwelling-place, of the temple|σκηνή]], [[were yoking again|were yoking again, were moving off, were breaking up, were moving, were breaking up and shifting one's quarters|ἀναζεύγνυμι]] the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[along with|along with and in company with and together with, with, endued with, to, attended with, in accordance with, with and by means of|σύν]] [[to the household utensils|to the household utensils and movables and chattels, to the spoil, to the public auction|ἀπαρτία]] of them;

names.gloss: (Ισραηλ, from Hebrew Yiśrāʾēl, which the Hebrew of Genesis 32:29 hears in śārâ ʿim ʾĕlōhîm, "he strove with God")

greek: εἰ δὲ μὴ ἀνέβη ἡ νεφέλη, οὐκ ἀνεζεύγνυσαν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας, ἧς ἀνέβη ἡ νεφέλη·
hint: They stay where they are until the day the cloud goes up.

notes.text: The relative in the genitive, attracted to τῆς ἡμέρας: of which.

reading: [[if|if, whether, come on|εἰ]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[not|not, that not, perhaps, surely not and you don't mean to say that|μή]] [[went up|went up, mounted, ascended, went up to, rose, came up, came to and arrived at, went up country, went aboard|ἀναβαίνω]] [[the cloud|the cloud, the bird-net|νεφέλη]], not [[were yoking again|were yoking again, were moving off, were breaking up, were moving, were breaking up and shifting one's quarters|ἀναζεύγνυμι]] [[until|until, till, while and so long as|ἕως]] [[of the day|of the day, of the day-break, of the time|ἡμέρα]], of which [[went up|went up, mounted, ascended, went up to, rose, came up, came to and arrived at, went up country, went aboard|ἀναβαίνω]] [[the cloud|the cloud, the bird-net|νεφέλη]];

greek: νεφέλη γὰρ ἦν ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς ἡμέρας καὶ πῦρ ἦν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς νυκτὸς ἐναντίον παντὸς Ισραηλ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἀναζυγαῖς αὐτῶν.
hint: Cloud by day and fire by night stay over the tent before all Israel on all their journeys.

notes.text: Not in Middle Liddell. LSJ gives it no gloss of its own, "= ἀνάζευξις", citing this verse, so it reads Middle Liddell's ἀνάζευξις, a marching off, return home, in the plural.
Genitives of time: of day, of night-season.
Twice, each with the imperfect's formula.

reading: [[a cloud|a cloud, a bird-net|νεφέλη]] [[for|for, since and as, for otherwise and else, now, but, why and what, would that|γάρ]], was, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one, [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] [[of the covered place|of the covered place and tent, of the camp, of the dwelling-place, of the temple|σκηνή]] [[of day|of day, of day-break, of time|ἡμέρα]] and [[fire|fire, the funeral-fire, the fire of the hearth|πῦρ]] was, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one, [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] of her [[of night-season|of night-season, of night, of the watches of the night, of the dark of night, of the night of death|νύξ]] [[in the presence of|in the presence of and before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] [[of all|of all, of the whole, of every, of every single|πᾶς]] of [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[in all|within, inside of, and by means of all, the whole, every, every single|ἐν; πᾶς]] [[to the marchings off|to the marchings off and returns home|ἀναζυγή]] of them.
